title: The Real Life Zombie Fungus
hook: You think zombie parasites hijack the brain, but this fungus leaves it completely untouched.
script: You think zombie parasites hijack the brain, but this fungus leaves it completely untouched. So how does the fungus drive a zombie ant with absolute precision? Fungal cells invade the muscle tissue, physically pulling limbs directly like a puppet. It forces the ant to climb 25 centimeters high and bite a leaf vein. Chemicals then destroy jaw muscles, locking the bite into a permanent death grip. The Ophiocordyceps fungus then erupts from the head to rain spores on the colony below. Is this biological horror worse than fiction, or do you know a scarier parasite?
